integrity: An explicit infinite proof is provided. A reproducible finite direct-greedy checker accompanies it; finite checks are corroboration, not a proof of automaticity or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Proof applies to coefficient pairs (a,3) for all a>=2 and does not settle arbitrary two-term forms or the full Clergyman conjecture. The a=1 example was previously established. Automaton size is an upper bound only; priority and proof have not had independent audit.
title: Uniform automaticity of the terminal-three anti-recurrence family
